no_outcome_promised.note: The draft acknowledges the request for written settlement terms but does not promise them or a settlement. 'Details you need on how to proceed' is informational and does not commit to an outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault or liability-conceding apology.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Only the standard 10-business-day timeframe and the owning team are given. No procedures, fees or policies are invented.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Both questions are restated specifically: who to talk to (answered by naming the owning team) and getting the settlement in writing before paying (acknowledged as passed for review).

tone.note: Warm, plain and encouraging without being condescending or scripted.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode: the draft names the owning team as instructed.
